column1: Select Flight page shows excessive empty space on responsive view
column26:
Steps to reproduce: 

# Activate responsive/mobile view (e.g., using Chrome DevTools).
# Navigate to the Select Flight page.
# Observe the layout: most of the screen appears empty, and the flight options are not properly scaled.
# *Expected Result:*
# The page should utilize screen space efficiently on responsive layouts, showing flight options and action buttons without excessive empty space.
# *Actual Result:*
# Around 80% of the screen is empty; flight cards and action buttons appear compressed toward the top.
